text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Duti Kastam (Tioman) 2025.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 November 2025.

Duti import

2. Duti import hendaklah dilevi atas dan dibayar oleh pengimport berkenaan

dengan barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual yang diimport masuk

ke dalam Tioman atau diangkut dari kawasan utama kastam ke Tioman

pada kadar duti import yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (5) Jadual Pertama kepada

Perintah Duti Kastam 2025 [P.U. (A) 384/2025].

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Duti Kastam (Tioman) 2004 [P.U. (A) 239/2004] dibatalkan.

JADUAL

[Perenggan 2]

(1)

Bil.

(2)

Barang-barang

1. Kenderaan motor

2. Rokok

3. Produk tembakau

4. Paip tembakau (termasuk kepala paip)

Dibuat 31 Oktober 2025

[SULIT KE.HT(96)669/12-2; MOF.700-2/1/16 JLD.16 (S) (16); PN(PU2)338B/JLD.23]

DATUK SERI AMIR HAMZAH AZIZAN

Menteri Kewangan II

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut subseksyen 163K(2) Akta Kastam 1967]

CUSTOMS ACT 1967

CUSTOMS DUTIES (TIOMAN) ORDER 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 163K(1)(a) of the Customs Act 1967

[Act 235] read together with paragraph 163L(b) of the Act, the Minister makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Customs Duties (Tioman) Order 2025.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 November 2025.

Import duty

2. Import duty shall be levied on and paid by the importer in respect of

the goods specified in the Schedule imported into Tioman or transported from

the principal customs area to Tioman at the rate of import duty specified in column (5)

of the First Schedule to the Customs Duties Order 2025 [P.U. (A) 384/2025].

Revocation

3. The Customs Duties (Tioman) Order 2004 [P.U. (A) 239/2004] is revoked.

SCHEDULE

[Paragraph 2]

(1)

No.

(2)

Goods

1. Motor vehicles

2. Cigarettes

3. Tobacco products

4. Smoking pipes (including pipe bowls)

Made 31 October 2025

[SULIT KE.HT(96)669/12-2; MOF.700-2/1/16 JLD.16 (S) (16); PN(PU2)338B/JLD.23]

DATUK SERI AMIR HAMZAH AZIZAN

Minister of Finance II

[To be laid before the Dewan Rakyat pursuant to subsection 163K(2) of the Customs Act 1967]
